escalation.suspected_cause: Third-party payments provider is in scheduled maintenance (ETA unknown), so every charge is refused with 503. Our payments connector and the shop are healthy.
escalation.evidence: payments log: "charge refused: provider-side scheduled maintenance in progress" (POST /charge 503). shop log: "payment rejected (HTTP 503): provider_maintenance ... ETA unknown". Smoke tests: 4/5 pass (health, catalog, latency, stats_integrity OK); checkout returns 502 payment_failed upstream_status 503. Both services are running, and the payments ledger has no charges.
escalation.actions_taken: Read-only investigation only: smoke tests, service status, metrics, shop and payments logs, payments ledger. No changes made. A restart would not help because the refusal comes from the provider, not from our process.
escalation.recommended_next_step: Contact the payments vendor or check their status page for the maintenance window and ETA. Consider a maintenance banner or disabling checkout until the provider is back. Once the provider recovers, re-run run_smoke_tests to confirm checkout returns 201 and the order is saved. Also confirm the order count in the DB and the ledger match.
